changelog: v2.4.1 - Fix: sitemap.xml (and news-sitemap.xml, llms.txt, robots.txt) are now served as a clean HTTP 200 instead of inheriting WordPress's 404 status, and run ahead of redirect_canonical so they are never bounced to another URL. The post-update rewrite-rule flush now also runs on the front end, so routes self-heal on the first visit after an update. v2.4.0 - Security hardening (JSON-LD escaping, nonce/url sanitization, updater host allowlist). v2.3.0 - Paginated XML sitemap index. v2.2.0 - Person entity, FAQ schema, canonical URLs, enhanced llms.txt, GitHub auto-updater.
